We're coming up on our anniversary and Legal has asked us to firm up the renewal path so we can budget for FY29. Two priorities from our side:

2) Run an APAC pilot (warm standby) that can be ramped to handle regional traffic within the first 90 days post-renewal.

Attached is the draft renewal our procurement team prepared (Salus_renewal_draft_v3.pdf). Legal specifically flagged the failover SLA and KMS requirements — they want explicit RTO/RPO and confirmation that keys for EU data remain EU-managed.

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the draft. High-level sequencing we recommend:

- Phase 1 (30 days): Contract renewal with EU residency guarantee for production (primary data stays in EU); sign amended Data Processing Addendum and KMS integration addendum.
- Phase 2 (30–90 days): Technical onboarding for APAC pilot (warm standby). This is a non-production standby region with encrypted cross-region KV replication.
- Phase 3 (90–120 days): If pilot metrics (latency, error budget usage, cost) meet thresholds, flip a staged failover (canary traffic to APAC).

Operational / SLA notes:
- Proposed RTO for cross-region failover: 5 minutes for routing + 15 minutes for cache warm-up (we can include a traffic-shed plan).
- Data residency: production PII and audit logs remain in EU. Backup metadata used for APAC warm standby is pseudonymized and encrypted with customer-controlled KMS (we can scope KeyWrap to EU HSM if required).
- Pricing: APAC warm standby is billed as 25% of equivalent dedicated capacity during pilot; permanent activation moves to standard regional capacity pricing.

I've attached an ops sketch (RIF-ops-proposal.xlsx) with suggested commit ranges and a sample SOW cadence. If Legal wants, we can produce a targeted artifact listing (SOC 2, encryption diagrams, KMS attestations).

Can we meet Tue 2028-02-21 10:00 CET / 04:00 EST for a 30-min sync? I will have Soojin (ops) and Vanessa (billing) on the call.

Cheers,

Thanks Marco / Elena — great sync today. Summary of agreed items and next steps to keep Legal within a 30–45 day window:

1) Sequencing & commitments
   - Sign 12-month renewal amendment that explicitly guarantees EU primary residency for production data and audit logs.
   - Add APAC Warm Standby pilot as an optional schedule: pilot billed at 25% pilot rate, with conversion clause to standard regional capacity on activation.

2) Security & KMS
   - Redwood will support customer-managed keys (BYOK) with keys provisioned in EU HSMs. KeyWrap entries for the APAC warm standby will be EU-scoped. Documentation bundle attached.

3) SLA / failover
   - Cross-region failover RTO target: 5 minutes routing + documented warm-up window (15 minutes). Failback runbook and a 48-hour post-incident report are included in the SOW.

4) Legal / procurement cadence
   - I attached a redline-ready amendment (20280301-salus-amendment-redline.pdf). If Legal can start review today we'll target signature within 30 days; we will also provide the requested security artifact bundle (SOC 2 excerpt, encryption diagram, KMS checklist).

5) Next actions
   - I will upload the amendment to DocuSign: https://docusign.com/redirect?doc=SLH-2028-RNWL-42
   - Vanessa (cc) will send PO / billing instructions and a small-print summary for procurement (expected cut: how the APAC pilot shows up on the invoice).
   - Soojin to share runbook and SRE onboarding checklist for the APAC pilot by 2028-03-05.

Please reply to confirm acceptance of the sequencing, or flag any Legal items that must be negotiated before we send DocuSign. If all good, I will kick the DocuSign flow end of day.
